build_descriptor_from_proto: build a protobuf Descriptor from a DescriptorProto using MakeDescriptor with a package name
review_FieldDescriptor_types: review the FieldDescriptor TYPE_* and CPPTYPE_* constants to map proto types to C++ types
create_FieldDescriptor: create a FieldDescriptor with name, number, type, label, and default value for a proto field
inspect_Descriptor_fields: inspect a Descriptor to list all fields, nested types, enum types, and extensions by name or number
parse_descriptor_options: parse serialized options from a descriptor using GetOptions to retrieve non-default proto options
